normal_transaction: one semantic generation followed by one audit; no automatic semantic retry
publication: all core tasks must have an approved audit receipt; optional display items may only be omitted or merged
selection: all completed logical attempts count, including generation, audit, transport and cancellation failures

stability.dimension_band: each dimension may vary by at most one adjacent fixed band
stability.top_priorities: at least two taskIds appear in every non-empty top-three list
stability.classification: safeCleanup versus informationNeeded is equal for each common taskId

boundary: synthetic evaluation only; no database seeding, planner execution, rewrite, blind judge or HTTP apply/finalize
